name: Everyday Sides
description: A versatile collection of potatoes, salads, slaws, vegetables, casseroles, rice, noodles, holiday favorites, and classic breads for completing family meals.

recipes.name: Creamy Southern Potato Salad

ingredients.item: Yukon Gold or russet potatoes, peeled and cut into 1-inch pieces

instructions: Place the potatoes in a large pot, cover with cold salted water, and bring to a boil. Cook for 10–15 minutes, until fork-tender but not falling apart.
Meanwhile, hard-boil the eggs, cool them in ice water, peel, and chop.
Drain the potatoes well and toss them gently with the vinegar while still warm. Cool for 15 minutes.
Whisk the mayonnaise, mustard, relish, salt, and pepper. Fold in the potatoes, eggs, celery, and onion.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours. Sprinkle with paprika before serving, if desired.
recipes.description: Tender potatoes, eggs, celery, and onion folded into a tangy mustard dressing for cookouts and family dinners.

recipes.name: Classic Creamy Coleslaw
instructions: Combine the cabbage, carrots, and onion, if using, in a large bowl.
Whisk the mayonnaise, vinegar, sugar, mustard, salt, pepper, and enough milk to make a pourable dressing.
Pour the dressing over the vegetables and toss thoroughly.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Toss again before serving.
recipes.description: Crisp cabbage and carrots dressed in a balanced creamy sauce with gentle sweetness and tang.

recipes.name: Sweet-and-Tangy Vinegar Slaw
instructions: Combine the cabbage, carrots, bell pepper, and onion in a large bowl.
Whisk the vinegar, oil, sugar, celery seed, salt, and pepper until the sugar dissolves.
Pour over the vegetables and toss well.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, tossing occasionally. Drain excess dressing before serving if desired.
recipes.description: A bright, mayo-free cabbage slaw with a lightly sweet vinegar dressing that holds well at picnics.

recipes.name: Homestyle Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook the macaroni in salted water until just tender. Drain, rinse under cool water, and drain thoroughly.
Whisk the mayonnaise, vinegar, mustard, sugar, salt, and pepper.
Combine the macaroni, eggs, celery, bell pepper, and onion. Fold in the dressing.
Cover and chill for at least 2 hours. Stir before serving and add a spoonful of mayonnaise if the salad has absorbed too much dressing.
recipes.description: Tender macaroni with eggs, celery, peppers, and a creamy sweet-tangy dressing.

recipes.name: Italian Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook the pasta in salted water until al dente. Drain and rinse briefly under cool water.
Whisk the olive oil, vinegar, Dijon, oregano, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Combine the pasta, tomatoes, cucumber, bell pepper, olives, and mozzarella.
Toss with the dressing, cover, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Toss again before serving.
recipes.description: Rotini tossed with tomatoes, cucumber, peppers, olives, mozzarella, and a lively herb vinaigrette.

recipes.name: Classic Deviled Eggs
instructions: Place the eggs in a saucepan, cover with cool water, and bring to a boil. Cover, remove from the heat, and let stand for 11–12 minutes.
Transfer the eggs to ice water, cool completely, and peel.
Halve the eggs lengthwise and place the yolks in a bowl. Mash with the mayonnaise, mustard, pickle juice, salt, and pepper until smooth.
Spoon or pipe the filling into the whites. Dust with paprika, if desired, and chill until serving.
recipes.description: Creamy, mustardy egg filling piped into tender whites and finished with paprika.

recipes.name: Loaded Twice-Baked Potatoes
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F. Rub the potatoes with olive oil, pierce them, and bake for 50–60 minutes, until tender.
Cool just enough to handle. Cut each potato in half lengthwise and scoop the flesh into a bowl, leaving sturdy shells.
Mash the potato with butter, sour cream, milk, 1 cup cheese, most of the bacon, chives, salt, and pepper.
Spoon the filling into the shells and top with the remaining cheese and bacon.
Bake for 15–20 minutes, until hot and lightly browned.
recipes.description: Crisp potato shells filled with buttery mashed potato, cheddar, sour cream, bacon, and chives.

recipes.name: Creamy Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F and grease a 9×13-inch baking dish.
Melt the butter in a saucepan. Add the garlic and flour and cook for 1 minute. Gradually whisk in the milk and cream.
Simmer for 3–5 minutes, until slightly thickened. Season with salt, pepper, and nutmeg, if using.
Layer the potatoes in the dish and pour the sauce evenly over them. Cover tightly with foil.
Bake for 50 minutes. Uncover and bake for 25–35 minutes more, until tender and browned. Rest for 15 minutes before serving.
recipes.description: Thin potato slices baked until tender in a silky garlic cream sauce with browned edges.

recipes.name: Cheesy Potatoes au Gratin
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F and grease a 9×13-inch baking dish.
Melt the butter in a saucepan and whisk in the flour. Cook for 2 minutes, then gradually whisk in the milk.
Cook until slightly thickened. Remove from the heat and stir in 1½ cups cheddar, Parmesan, salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
Layer the potatoes in the dish and pour the cheese sauce evenly over them. Cover with foil.
Bake for 55 minutes. Uncover, top with the remaining cheddar, and bake for 25–30 minutes more, until tender and golden. Rest for 15 minutes.
recipes.description: Tender sliced potatoes layered with a rich cheddar-Parmesan sauce and baked beneath a golden cheese crust.

recipes.name: Loaded Mashed Potato Casserole

ingredients.item: russet or Yukon Gold potatoes, peeled and cubed

instructions: Place the potatoes in salted water and boil for 15–20 minutes, until very tender. Drain well.
Mash with the butter, sour cream, milk, 1 cup cheese, half the bacon, salt, and pepper.
Spread in a greased 9×13-inch baking dish. Top with the remaining cheese and bacon.
Bake at 375°F for 25–30 minutes, until hot and lightly browned.
Garnish with chives before serving.
recipes.description: Creamy mashed potatoes baked with cheddar, sour cream, bacon, and a golden cheesy top.

recipes.name: Maple-Cinnamon Sweet Potatoes

ingredients.item: sweet potatoes, peeled and cut into 1-inch cubes

instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F and line a large baking sheet.
Toss the sweet potatoes with melted butter, maple syrup, cinnamon, salt, and nutmeg, if using.
Spread in a single layer.
Roast for 30–40 minutes, turning halfway through, until browned at the edges and tender.
recipes.description: Roasted sweet potato cubes glazed with butter, maple syrup, cinnamon, and a pinch of salt.

recipes.name: Classic Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Boil the sweet potatoes in salted water for 15–20 minutes, until very tender. Drain well.
Preheat the oven to 350°F and grease a 9×13-inch baking dish.
Mash the potatoes with ¼ cup butter, ¼ cup brown sugar, milk, eggs, vanilla, cinnamon, and salt. Spread in the dish.
Combine the pecans, flour, remaining brown sugar, and remaining melted butter. Sprinkle over the potatoes.
Bake for 30–35 minutes, until hot and browned on top.
recipes.description: Smooth cinnamon-spiced sweet potatoes baked beneath a buttery brown-sugar pecan topping.

recipes.name: Homemade Green Bean Casserole

ingredients.item: fresh green beans, trimmed and cut

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F. Blanch the green beans in boiling salted water for 4 minutes, then cool in ice water and drain.
Melt the butter in a skillet. Cook the mushrooms for 6–8 minutes, then add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute. Gradually add the broth and milk. Simmer until thickened; season with salt and pepper.
Fold in the green beans and half of the fried onions. Transfer to a 9×13-inch baking dish.
Bake for 20 minutes. Top with the remaining onions and bake for 8–10 minutes more.
recipes.description: Green beans and mushrooms in a creamy homemade sauce, topped with crisp fried onions.

recipes.name: Old-Fashioned Corn Pudding
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F and butter a 2½-quart baking dish.
Whisk the eggs, milk, cream, sugar, flour, melted butter, salt, and pepper until smooth.
Stir in the corn and pour into the baking dish.
Bake for 45–55 minutes, until lightly golden and just set in the center.
Rest for 10 minutes before serving.
recipes.description: A soft, custardy corn casserole with buttery edges and gentle natural sweetness.

recipes.name: Creamed Corn
instructions: Melt the butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the corn and cook for 3 minutes.
Stir in the cream, milk, sugar, salt, and pepper. Simmer gently for 8–10 minutes.
Whisk the flour with the water until smooth. Stir it into the corn and simmer for 2–3 minutes, until lightly thickened.
Taste and adjust the seasoning before serving.
recipes.description: Sweet corn simmered in a rich, lightly thickened cream sauce with butter and black pepper.

recipes.name: Skillet Bacon Corn
instructions: Cook the bacon in a large skillet until crisp. Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate, leaving 2 tablespoons drippings.
Cook the onion in the drippings for 3–4 minutes, until softened.
Add the corn, butter, paprika, salt, and pepper. Cook for 6–8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until hot and lightly browned.
Stir in the bacon and serve.
recipes.description: Sweet corn sautéed with crisp bacon, onion, and butter for a fast, savory side.

recipes.name: Slow-Baked Homestyle Beans

ingredients.item: navy or great northern beans, drained

instructions: Preheat the oven to 325°F.
Cook the bacon in a Dutch oven or oven-safe pot until partly crisp. Add the onion and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the beans, ketchup, brown sugar, molasses, mustard, vinegar, Worcestershire, paprika, and pepper.
Bake uncovered for 1½–2 hours, stirring once or twice, until thick and bubbling.
Rest for 10 minutes before serving.
recipes.description: Tender beans baked in a sweet, tangy, smoky sauce with bacon and onion.

recipes.name: Brown Sugar Glazed Carrots
instructions: Combine the carrots and water in a large skillet. Cover and cook over medium heat for 6–8 minutes, until nearly tender.
Uncover and drain any excess water.
Add the butter, brown sugar, salt, and cinnamon, if using.
Cook for 4–6 minutes, stirring frequently, until the carrots are tender and glazed.
recipes.description: Tender carrots coated in a glossy butter and brown-sugar glaze with a touch of cinnamon.

recipes.name: Broccoli Rice Casserole
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F and grease a 9×13-inch baking dish.
Melt 3 tablespoons butter in a saucepan and cook the onion for 4 minutes. Stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually whisk in the milk. Simmer until thickened, then stir in 1½ cups cheese, salt, garlic powder, and pepper.
Fold together the rice, broccoli, and cheese sauce. Spread in the dish and top with the remaining cheese.
Combine the crackers with melted butter and sprinkle over the casserole. Bake for 25–30 minutes, until bubbling and golden.
recipes.description: Tender broccoli and rice baked in a creamy cheddar sauce beneath a buttery cracker topping.

recipes.name: Cheesy Cauliflower Bake
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F. Steam or boil the cauliflower for 5–6 minutes, until barely tender, then drain well.
Melt 3 tablespoons butter in a saucepan. Whisk in the flour for 1 minute, then gradually add the milk.
Simmer until thickened. Stir in the cheddar, half the Parmesan, salt, garlic powder, and pepper.
Combine the cauliflower and cheese sauce in a greased baking dish.
Mix the breadcrumbs, remaining Parmesan, and melted butter. Sprinkle over the top and bake for 20–25 minutes, until golden.
recipes.description: Tender cauliflower baked in a smooth cheddar sauce with a crisp Parmesan breadcrumb topping.

recipes.name: Savory Herb Bread Dressing
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F and grease a 9×13-inch baking dish.
Melt the butter in a large skillet. Cook the onion and celery for 8–10 minutes, until softened.
Place the bread cubes in a large bowl. Add the vegetables, sage, thyme, parsley, salt, and pepper.
Stir in the eggs and enough broth to moisten the bread without making it soggy.
Spread in the dish, cover, and bake for 25 minutes. Uncover and bake for 20–25 minutes more, until golden and at least 165°F in the center.
recipes.description: Classic oven-baked dressing with buttery bread cubes, celery, onion, sage, and thyme.

recipes.name: Cranberry-Pecan Herb Dressing
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F and grease a 9×13-inch baking dish.
Melt the butter in a skillet. Cook the onion and celery for 8–10 minutes.
Combine the bread, vegetables, cranberries, pecans, sage, thyme, salt, and pepper.
Stir in the eggs and enough broth to evenly moisten the bread.
Cover and bake for 25 minutes. Uncover and bake for 20–25 minutes more, until golden and at least 165°F in the center.
recipes.description: Savory herb dressing brightened with dried cranberries and toasted pecans for holiday meals.

recipes.name: Buttered Egg Noodles
instructions: Cook the noodles in salted water according to the package directions. Reserve ¼ cup cooking water, then drain.
Melt the butter in the pot over medium heat. Cook for 2–3 minutes, until lightly browned and nutty-smelling.
Return the noodles to the pot and toss with the butter, Parmesan, parsley, salt, and pepper.
Add a splash of reserved cooking water if needed and serve immediately.
recipes.description: Tender egg noodles tossed with browned butter, parsley, and a touch of Parmesan.

recipes.name: Classic Rice Pilaf
instructions: Rinse the rice under cool water and drain well.
Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Cook the onion for 4 minutes, then add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the rice and stir for 2–3 minutes, until lightly toasted.
Add the broth, salt, and pepper. Bring to a boil, cover, reduce the heat to low, and cook for 16–18 minutes.
Remove from the heat and rest, covered, for 10 minutes. Fluff with a fork and add parsley, if using.
recipes.description: Fluffy long-grain rice toasted with onion and butter, then simmered in savory broth.

recipes.name: Mushroom Wild Rice
instructions: Cook the wild-rice blend in the broth according to package timing, until tender. Drain any excess liquid.
Meanwhile, melt the butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the mushrooms without crowding until browned, 7–9 minutes.
Add the onion and cook for 4 minutes. Add the garlic and thyme and cook for 30 seconds.
Fold in the cooked rice and season with salt and pepper. Cook for 2 minutes, until hot.
recipes.description: Nutty wild-rice blend cooked with browned mushrooms, onion, garlic, and herbs.

recipes.name: Garlic-Parmesan Orzo
instructions: Melt the butter in a large saucepan over medium heat. Cook the garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the orzo and stir for 2 minutes to lightly toast it.
Add the broth and bring to a simmer. Cook for 8–10 minutes, stirring often, until the orzo is tender and most liquid is absorbed.
Stir in the milk, Parmesan, salt, and pepper. Cook for 1–2 minutes, until creamy.
Garnish with parsley, if using, and serve promptly.
recipes.description: Small pasta cooked until creamy with broth, garlic, butter, and Parmesan.

recipes.name: Southern Fried Cabbage with Bacon

ingredients.item: large head green cabbage, cored and chopped

instructions: Cook the bacon in a large skillet or Dutch oven until crisp. Transfer it to a plate, leaving 2–3 tablespoons drippings.
Cook the onion in the drippings for 5 minutes. Add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the cabbage, broth, paprika, black pepper, and red pepper, if using. Toss well.
Cover and cook for 10 minutes. Uncover and cook for 8–12 minutes more, stirring occasionally, until tender and lightly browned.
Stir in the bacon and taste before adding salt.
recipes.description: Tender cabbage sautéed with bacon and onion until savory, lightly sweet, and browned at the edges.

recipes.name: Crispy Cornmeal Hush Puppies
instructions: Heat 2–3 inches of oil in a heavy pot to 350°F.
Whisk the cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt. Stir in the onion.
Whisk the egg with ¾ cup buttermilk. Stir into the dry ingredients, adding more buttermilk only until a thick scoopable batter forms.
Drop rounded tablespoons of batter into the oil without crowding. Fry for 2–3 minutes, turning, until deep golden.
Drain on a wire rack or paper towels and serve hot.
recipes.description: Golden cornmeal fritters with tender centers, mild onion flavor, and crisp ridged edges.

recipes.name: Skillet Buttermilk Cornbread
instructions: Place a 10-inch cast-iron skillet in the oven and preheat to 425°F.
Whisk the cornmeal, flour, baking powder, salt, and sugar, if using.
Whisk the buttermilk, eggs, and melted butter. Stir into the dry ingredients just until combined.
Carefully remove the hot skillet and add the remaining butter. Swirl to coat, then pour in the batter.
Bake for 18–24 minutes, until golden and a toothpick comes out clean. Cool for 10 minutes before slicing.
recipes.description: A savory, tender cornbread with a crisp buttered crust from a preheated cast-iron skillet.

recipes.name: Soft Garlic Dinner Rolls
instructions: Combine the warm milk, yeast, and sugar. Rest for 5–10 minutes, until foamy.
Mix in the egg, ¼ cup melted butter, 3 cups flour, and salt. Knead for 6–8 minutes, adding only enough remaining flour to make a soft dough.
Place in a greased bowl, cover, and let rise until doubled, 60–90 minutes.
Divide into 12 balls and arrange in a greased 9×13-inch dish. Cover and rise for 30–45 minutes.
Bake at 375°F for 18–22 minutes, until golden.
Combine the brushing butter, garlic, and parsley. Brush over the hot rolls.
recipes.description: Pillowy pull-apart rolls brushed with garlic-herb butter for serving beside family dinners.
